0.content: **All Flash**: For namespaces with the primary index on flash: index, data and OS resources. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

1.content:
### Objects per Sprig (Primary Index)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series that are already summarized, sorted or counted). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
sum(aerospike_namespace_master_objects {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"}) / 4096
/ 
min(aerospike_namespace_partition_tree_sprigs{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"}!=0)

```

2.title: Latencies > 4ms (total)
2.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) and le == "+Inf" }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) and le == "4" }, rollup: avg), a2 = sum(aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) and le == "+Inf" }, rollup: avg), a3 = sum(aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) and le == "4" }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd write_4ms = (a0[] - a1[]), read_4ms = (a2[] - a3[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3
| fields write_4ms = coalesce(write_4ms[-2], arrayLast(write_4ms)), read_4ms = coalesce(read_4ms[-2], arrayLast(read_4ms))
2.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns="$namespace", le="+Inf"})
- 
sum (aerospike_latencies_write_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns="$namespace",  le="4"}) 
sum (aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns="$namespace", le="+Inf",}) 
- 
sum (aerospike_latencies_read_ms_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns="$namespace", le="4",})

| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
3.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:

20.title: % Data - used, available (topk)
20.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
topk($topk_limit, 100 - aerospike_namespace_device_free_pct{cluster_name="$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"} )
topk($topk_limit, aerospike_namespace_device_available_pct {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"} )
topk($topk_limit,100 - aerospike_namespace_pmem_free_pct {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
topk($topk_limit, aerospike_namespace_pmem_available_pct {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"} )
topk($topk_limit, aerospike_namespace_data_used_pct {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
topk($topk_limit, aerospike_namespace_data_avail_pct {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"} )
